| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 将 CYLTabBarController 迁移到 Android（Gradle 模块 `cyltabbar`）的过程中，与腾讯 [QMUI_Android](https://github.com/Tencent/QMUI_Android) 的 Tab 实现做对比。QMUI 中的 Tab 组件名为 `QMUITabSegment` / `QMUITabSegment2`（基类 `QMUIBasicTabSegment`，配合 `QMUITabBuilder`、`QMUITab`、`QMUITabIndicator`、`QMUITabView`，约 3,600 行 Java），换肤为 `QMUISkinManager`（`com.qmuiteam.qmui.skin`，约 2,400 行）。对比基于 QMUI `master` 的提交 `026e7d4`（2023-07-19，目前最新）与本仓库的 `cyltabbar`（约 8,600 行 Kotlin，测试约 1,000 行）。之后加入 [XUI](https://github.com/xuexiangjys/XUI)（`com.xuexiang.xui.widget.tabbar`：`TabSegment`、`EasyIndicator`、`TabControlView`、`VerticalTabLayout`，约 5,200 行 Java；提交 `111e600`，2023-06-26，Apache-2.0）：它的 `TabSegment` 是 QMUI 旧版 `TabSegment` 的分支，没有运行时换肤，主题是 Activity 的编译期 style。每个维度满分 100 分，总分为各维度的平均分，三者使用相同的评分规则。 | While porting CYLTabBarController to Android (the Gradle module `cyltabbar`), we compared it with the tabs of Tencent's [QMUI_Android](https://github.com/Tencent/QMUI_Android). There the tab component is `QMUITabSegment` / `QMUITabSegment2` (base class `QMUIBasicTabSegment`, with `QMUITabBuilder`, `QMUITab`, `QMUITabIndicator` and `QMUITabView`; about 3,600 lines of Java), and skinning is `QMUISkinManager` (`com.qmuiteam.qmui.skin`, about 2,400 lines). The comparison uses QMUI `master` at `026e7d4` (2023-07-19, the latest commit) and this repository's `cyltabbar` (about 8,600 lines of Kotlin, plus about 1,000 lines of tests). [XUI](https://github.com/xuexiangjys/XUI) was added later (`com.xuexiang.xui.widget.tabbar`: `TabSegment`, `EasyIndicator`, `TabControlView`, `VerticalTabLayout`; about 5,200 lines of Java; commit `111e600`, 2023-06-26, Apache-2.0): its `TabSegment` is a fork of QMUI's older `TabSegment`, and it has no runtime skins, a theme being the activity's compiled style. Each dimension is scored out of 100; the total is the average of the dimensions, with the same rules for all three. |

## [CN]总分
## [EN]Totals

| 表格 Table | CYLTabBarController | QMUI_Android | XUI | 差距 Gap（对 QMUI / 对 XUI） |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Tab 实现（19 个维度） / The tab implementation (19 dimensions) | **79 → 88** | **60** | **52** | +28 / +36 |
| 主题切换与换肤（16 个维度） / Theme switching and skins (16 dimensions) | **77 → 87** | **61** | **30** | +26 / +57 |

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 「79 → 88」表示首次对比时的分数 → 移植 QMUI 落后维度之后的分数（见[已移植](#cn已移植)）。 | "79 → 88" is the score at the first comparison → the score after porting QMUI's code for the dimensions where we were behind (see [Ported](#enported)). |
| 两者定位不同：CYLTabBarController 是带页面管理的底部 TabBarController（对应 iOS 的 `UITabBarController`），QMUI 是顶部 / 底部通用的分段 Tab 控件，页面交给 `ViewPager` / `ViewPager2`。CYL 胜在页面管理、PlusButton、动画图标、配置文件、测试与持续维护；首次对比时 QMUI 胜在指示器、可滚动模式、滑动翻页联动、Maven 发布与生产验证，以及可覆盖任意 View 的换肤体系；移植之后，QMUI 仍领先的是 Maven 发布与生产验证、一行代码绑定 ViewPager2 与按权重分配宽度。 | The two aim at different things: CYLTabBarController is a bottom tab bar controller that manages pages (the Android counterpart of iOS `UITabBarController`); QMUI's is a general segmented tab control for the top or the bottom that leaves the pages to `ViewPager` / `ViewPager2`. CYL wins on page management, the plus button, animated icons, configuration files, tests and active maintenance; At the first comparison QMUI won on the indicator, the scrollable mode, swipe paging, Maven distribution, production use, and a skin system that reaches any view; after the port, QMUI still leads on Maven distribution and production use, a one-line ViewPager2 binding and widths by weight. |
| XUI 两项都最低（52、30）：Tab 是 QMUI 旧版控件的分支，QMUI 领先的部分已经移植，XUI 没有超过 QMUI 或 CYL 的维度；换肤只能 `recreate()`。CYL 两项都最高，因此不需要大批量复制 QMUI 或 XUI 的代码；仍落后的维度（Maven 发布与生产验证、一行代码绑定 ViewPager2、按权重分配宽度）见[已移植](#cn已移植)末尾。XUI 的竖向 Tab 与分段控件（`VerticalTabLayout`、`TabControlView`）不属于底部 TabBarController 的范围。 | XUI scores lowest on both (52, 30): its tabs are a fork of QMUI's older control, whose leads are already ported, so no XUI dimension beats QMUI or CYL; its skins need `recreate()`. CYL scores highest on both, so there is no need to copy QMUI's or XUI's code in bulk; the dimensions still behind (Maven distribution and production use, a one-line ViewPager2 binding, widths by weight) are listed at the end of [Ported](#enported). XUI's vertical tabs and segmented control (`VerticalTabLayout`, `TabControlView`) are outside a bottom tab bar controller's scope. |

## [CN]Tab 实现评分
## [EN]Scores of the tab implementation

| 维度 Dimension | CYL | QMUI | XUI | 说明 | Notes |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---|:---|
| 定位与页面管理 / Scope and page management | 95 | 60 | 60 | CYL 管理 Fragment 页面、每个 Tab 的返回栈（`cyl_pushViewController`）与生命周期；QMUI 只是控件，页面由 ViewPager 管理；XUI：`TabSegment` 同样只是控件；`VerticalTabLayout` 配合 `TabFragmentManager` 管理竖向 Tab 的 Fragment | CYL manages fragment pages, a back stack per tab (`cyl_pushViewController`) and their lifecycle; QMUI is a control only, ViewPager manages the pages; XUI: `TabSegment` is a control too; `VerticalTabLayout` with `TabFragmentManager` manages fragments for vertical tabs |
| Tab 内容与布局 / Item content and layout | 85 → 88 | 90 | 80 | QMUI：图标在上 / 下 / 左 / 右、宽高限制、图标缩放、字重渐变、间距；CYL：图标标题、布局样式、标题偏移、FlatDesign / Liquid Glass 样式；XUI：QMUI 旧版 `TabSegment` 的分支，图标四个方向与数字提示，无字重渐变 | QMUI: icon top / bottom / left / right, size limits, icon scale, typeface weight transition, gaps; CYL: icon and title, layout styles, title offsets, FlatDesign / Liquid Glass styles; XUI: a fork of QMUI's older `TabSegment`, icons on four sides and a count, no typeface transition |
| 选中动画 / Selection animation | 95 → 97 | 80 | 65 | CYL：点击动画、页面转场、Lottie / PAG / Rive / GIF 动画图标；QMUI：颜色插值、指示器滑动、图标缩放；XUI：颜色变化与指示器滑动 | CYL: tap animations, page transitions, Lottie / PAG / Rive / GIF icons; QMUI: color interpolation, sliding indicator, icon scale; XUI: color change and a sliding indicator |
| 指示器与滚动模式 / Indicator and scroll mode | 20 → 95 | 95 | 90 | QMUI 有指示器、固定 / 可滚动模式、按权重分配宽度；CYL 移植后有 `cyl_indicator`（颜色或 drawable、上 / 下、跟随内容宽度、圆角、移动动画）与 `cyl_scrollMode`（按内容定宽、拖动与惯性滚动、选中 Tab 自动滚到中间），以及按权重分配宽度（`cyl_itemWidthWeights`）；XUI：指示器、固定 / 可滚动模式，另有 `EasyIndicator` | QMUI has an indicator, fixed / scrollable modes and width by weight; after the port CYL has `cyl_indicator` (a color or a drawable, top / bottom, content width, corners, a moving animation) and `cyl_scrollMode` (width by content, drag and fling, the selected tab scrolled to the middle), and widths by weight (`cyl_itemWidthWeights`); XUI: an indicator, fixed / scrollable modes, plus `EasyIndicator` |
| 滑动翻页联动 / Swipe paging | 30 → 95 | 90 | 80 | QMUI `setupWithViewPager` 与 ViewPager2 联动；CYL 移植后有内置的 `cyl_swipesBetweenPages`（相邻页面跟随手指、子视图可横向滚动时不抢手势、遵守 `shouldSelect` 与登录），App 自己的翻页控件可调用 `cyl_updateIndicatorPosition`；`cyl_setupWithViewPager2` 一行代码把页面放进 ViewPager2；XUI：`setupWithViewPager` 只支持 ViewPager，不支持 ViewPager2 | QMUI follows ViewPager / ViewPager2 (`setupWithViewPager`); after the port CYL has a built-in `cyl_swipesBetweenPages` (the neighbor page follows the finger, a child that scrolls sideways keeps the drag, `shouldSelect` and login are respected), and an app's own pager can call `cyl_updateIndicatorPosition`; `cyl_setupWithViewPager2` puts the pages in a ViewPager2 in one line; XUI: `setupWithViewPager` for ViewPager only, no ViewPager2 |
| 角标 / Badges | 90 | 75 | 65 | CYL：数字、文字、红点、颜色、偏移、选中时隐藏；QMUI：数字与红点及其边距；XUI：数字与红点（`signCount`） | CYL: numbers, text, dots, colors, offsets, hiding on the selected tab; QMUI: numbers and dots with margins; XUI: a count or a dot (`signCount`) |
| 中间凸起按钮 / Raised center button | 95 | 0 | 0 | CYL `CYLPlusButton`（可绑定页面、角标、动画）；QMUI 无；XUI 无 | CYL `CYLPlusButton` (with a page, a badge, animations); QMUI has none; XUI has none |
| 配置与动态化 / Configuration and dynamic tabs | 98 | 55 | 50 | CYL：JSON / YAML / plist 等配置文件、网络 URL、页面注册表、按平台与版本过滤、异步页面；QMUI：代码 Builder，`replaceTab` / `notifyDataChanged`；XUI：代码 Builder 与 `notifyDataChanged` | CYL: configuration files (JSON, YAML, plist and more), network URLs, a page registry, filtering by platform and version, asynchronous pages; QMUI: a builder in code, `replaceTab` / `notifyDataChanged`; XUI: a builder in code and `notifyDataChanged` |
| 事件与手势 / Events and gestures | 90 | 85 | 80 | 两者都有选中、取消、重复选中、双击；CYL 另有长按、`shouldSelect` 与代理；XUI：选中、取消、重复选中、双击 | Both have select, unselect, reselect and double tap; CYL adds long press, `shouldSelect` and a delegate; XUI: select, unselect, reselect and double tap |
| 跨平台一致性 / Cross-platform consistency | 95 | 30 | 20 | CYL 与 iOS 共用同一份配置文件与 API 名称；QMUI 的 iOS 版本 API 不同；XUI 只有 Android | CYL shares the configuration file and API names with iOS; QMUI's iOS library has a different API; XUI is Android only |
| API 设计 / API design | 75 | 80 | 70 | QMUI 是流畅的 Java Builder；CYL 用 Kotlin，但保留 iOS 风格的 `cyl_` 前缀名；XUI：Java setter，沿用 QMUI 旧版 API | QMUI has a fluent Java builder; CYL is Kotlin but keeps iOS-style `cyl_` names; XUI: Java setters, QMUI's older API |
| 测试 / Tests | 85 → 88 | 10 | 5 | CYL 有 Robolectric 单元测试（cyltabbar 51、tabpages 11，另有示例测试）；QMUI 只有模板测试；XUI 没有测试 | CYL has Robolectric unit tests (51 in cyltabbar, 11 in tabpages, plus example tests); QMUI has template tests only; XUI has no tests |
| 持续集成与静态分析 / CI and static analysis | 60 → 85 | 20 | 15 | CYL 有 SonarCloud、lint，GitHub Actions 运行 Gradle 测试、lint、release 构建与 Maven 包检查（`android.yml`）；QMUI 无 CI；XUI 无 CI，只有 JitPack 构建 | CYL has SonarCloud and lint, but GitHub Actions does not run Gradle yet; QMUI has no CI; XUI has no CI, only JitPack builds |
| 文档 / Documentation | 90 | 60 | 60 | CYL 有中英双语文档与 API 对照表；QMUI 靠 Wiki 与示例；XUI 靠 README、Wiki 与博客 | CYL has bilingual documents and an API map; QMUI relies on its wiki and demo; XUI relies on its README, wiki and blog posts |
| 示例 / Demos | 90 → 85 | 85 | 85 | CYL 有 4 个示例 App，Android 15 模拟器上发现并修复了系统栏遮挡 Tab 与 PlusButton 被裁剪（#784），Rive 原生库加载报错仍待查；QMUI 的 `qmuidemo` 有 6 个 Tab 示例；XUI 的示例 App 有 TabSegment 与 TabLayout 页面并提供 APK | CYL has 4 example apps; the Android 15 emulator showed the system bars covering the tabs and the plus button clipped, both fixed (#784), and a Rive native library error is still open; QMUI's `qmuidemo` has 6 tab demos; XUI's demo app has TabSegment and TabLayout pages and ships an APK |
| 发布与成熟度 / Distribution and maturity | 35 | 80 | 65 | QMUI 已发布到 Maven Central，并在腾讯产品中长期使用；CYL 的 Android 库尚未发布到 Maven；XUI 通过 JitPack 发布，使用广泛 | QMUI is on Maven Central and long used in Tencent products; CYL's Android library is not on Maven yet; XUI is on JitPack and widely used |
| 维护活跃度 / Maintenance | 95 | 30 | 25 | QMUI 最后一次提交是 2023-07；CYL 持续开发；XUI 最后一次提交是 2023-06 | QMUI's last commit is from 2023-07; CYL is under active development; XUI's last commit is from 2023-06 |
| 工具链 / Toolchain | 90 | 60 | 30 | CYL：AGP 8.7、compileSdk 35、minSdk 23、Kotlin 2.0；QMUI：compileSdk 31、minSdk 21；XUI：AGP 3.6.1、Gradle 5.6.4、targetSdk 29、minSdk 19，无法用新版 JDK 构建 | CYL: AGP 8.7, compileSdk 35, minSdk 23, Kotlin 2.0; QMUI: compileSdk 31, minSdk 21; XUI: AGP 3.6.1, Gradle 5.6.4, targetSdk 29, minSdk 19, which do not build on current JDKs |
| 体积与依赖 / Size and dependencies | 85 | 60 | 45 | CYL 的动画库是可选的（通过反射调用）；QMUI 的 Tab 需要引入整个 `qmui` 库；XUI 的 Tab 需要引入整个 XUI 组件库 | CYL's animation libraries are optional (called through reflection); QMUI's tabs need the whole `qmui` library; XUI's tabs need the whole XUI widget library |
| **平均 / Average** | **79 → 88** | **60** | **52** | | |

## [CN]主题切换与换肤评分
## [EN]Scores of theme switching and skins

| 维度 Dimension | CYL | QMUI | XUI | 说明 | Notes |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---|:---|
| 架构 / Architecture | 85 → 90 | 90 | 40 | QMUI：每套皮肤是一个 style，View 通过属性取值；CYL：`CYLThemeManager` 按标识管理任意主题对象；XUI 没有换肤管理器：主题是 Activity 的编译期 style（`XUITheme.Phone` 等） | QMUI: each skin is a style and views read attributes from it; CYL: `CYLThemeManager` manages any theme object by identifier; XUI has no skin manager: a theme is the activity's compiled style (`XUITheme.Phone`...) |
| 任意 View 覆盖 / Reaching any view | 70 → 92 | 95 | 50 | QMUI 通过 XML 属性、`LayoutInflater` Factory 与 20 种规则覆盖任意 View；CYL 移植后有主题值：`app:cyl_theme…` 布局属性与 `CYLThemeLayoutInflaterFactory`、`CYLThemeValueBuilder`、15 种内置规则与 `setRuleHandler`，值来自 style、Map 或 provider（QMUI 另有 5 种只用于其自带控件的规则）；XUI 的组件通过 `?attr` 读取主题，但切换需要 `recreate()` | QMUI reaches any view through XML attributes, a `LayoutInflater` factory and 20 rule handlers; after the port CYL has theme values: `app:cyl_theme…` layout attributes with `CYLThemeLayoutInflaterFactory`, `CYLThemeValueBuilder`, 15 built-in rules and `setRuleHandler`, with values from a style, a Map or a provider (QMUI's other 5 rules serve only its own widgets); XUI's widgets read the theme through `?attr`, but switching needs `recreate()` |
| TabBar 专属主题 / Tab bar themes | 98 | 75 | 40 | CYL `CYLTabBarTheme` 可替换 Tab、PlusButton、外观并自定义控制器；QMUI 只换 Tab 的颜色、图片与着色；XUI 只能在 style 中设置 Tab 颜色 | CYL `CYLTabBarTheme` replaces the tabs, the plus button and the appearance and customizes the controller; QMUI changes only tab colors, drawables and tints; XUI sets tab colors in the style only |
| 运行时与远程皮肤 / Runtime and remote skins | 90 | 40 | 10 | CYL 支持主题生成器与网络图标；QMUI 皮肤只能是编译期的 style；XUI 无 | CYL has theme generators and network icons; QMUI skins are compiled styles only; XUI has none |
| 恢复原样 / Restoring the original | 90 | 60 | 40 | CYL 去掉主题时恢复 App 原本的 Tab 与 PlusButton；QMUI 只能切换到另一套皮肤；XUI 只能 `recreate()` 回原来的主题 | CYL restores the app's own tabs and plus button when a theme is removed; QMUI can only switch to another skin; XUI can only `recreate()` with the old theme |
| 深色模式 / Dark mode | 85 | 55 | 45 | CYL `identifierForTrait` 跟随系统；QMUI 由 App 自己判断 `uiMode` 后切换；XUI 由 App 自己处理 | CYL follows the system with `identifierForTrait`; with QMUI the app checks `uiMode` and switches itself; XUI leaves it to the app |
| 持久化 / Persistence | 85 | 30 | 20 | CYL `persistIn(context)`；QMUI 库内没有，示例自己保存；XUI 无 | CYL has `persistIn(context)`; QMUI's library has none, its demo saves the index itself; XUI has none |
| 多个管理器 / Several managers | 85 | 85 | 10 | 两者都支持命名的多个管理器（`themeManagerWithName` / `QMUISkinManager.of`）；XUI 无 | Both support several named managers (`themeManagerWithName` / `QMUISkinManager.of`); XUI has none |
| 切换过渡动画 / Transition animation | 25 → 80 | 20 | 10 | CYL 的 `themeChangeAnimationDuration` 与 iOS 一样交叉淡入淡出（窗口截图在其上淡出）；QMUI 无；XUI 的 `recreate()` 会闪烁 | CYL declares `themeChangeAnimationDuration` but does not use it yet; QMUI has none; XUI's `recreate()` flashes |
| 监听 / Listeners | 85 | 85 | 10 | 两者都有切换监听；XUI 无 | Both have change listeners; XUI has none |
| 列表与富文本 / Lists and spans | 40 → 80 | 90 | 30 | QMUI 支持 RecyclerView 分割线与 Span；CYL 移植后有 `CYLThemeSpan`、`CYLThemeColorSpan` 与 `CYLThemeItemDecoration`（通过反射访问 RecyclerView，未用真实 RecyclerView 测试）；XUI 无专门支持 | QMUI handles RecyclerView decorations and spans; after the port CYL has `CYLThemeSpan`, `CYLThemeColorSpan` and `CYLThemeItemDecoration` (the RecyclerView is reached by reflection and was not tested with a real one); XUI has no special support |
| 性能 / Performance | 65 → 80 | 85 | 40 | QMUI 有分发策略、拦截与缓存；CYL 移植后每次变化每个视图只处理一次、缓存反射方法与属性 id、可拦截（`cyl_interceptsThemeDispatch`、`CYLThemeDispatchInterceptor`），新附加的视图自动跟上；XUI 切换要重建 Activity | QMUI has dispatch strategies, interception and caching; after the port CYL handles each view once per change, caches reflected methods and attribute ids, can intercept (`cyl_interceptsThemeDispatch`, `CYLThemeDispatchInterceptor`), and views attached later catch up; XUI rebuilds the activity to switch |
| 易用性 / Ease of use | 85 | 75 | 60 | CYL 一行切换并自动作用于 TabBar；QMUI 需要在布局或代码里为每个 View 声明皮肤属性；XUI 在清单中设置主题即可，但不能运行时换肤 | CYL switches in one line and reaches the tab bar automatically; QMUI needs skin attributes declared for each view in layouts or code; XUI only needs a theme in the manifest, but cannot switch at runtime |
| 测试 / Tests | 60 → 75 | 10 | 5 | CYL 有主题相关单元测试；QMUI 无；XUI 无 | CYL has theme unit tests; QMUI has none; XUI has none |
| 文档 / Documentation | 90 | 55 | 55 | CYL 有双语主题文档；QMUI 靠 Wiki；XUI 靠 README | CYL has bilingual theme documents; QMUI relies on its wiki; XUI relies on its README |
| 跨平台一致性 / Cross-platform consistency | 95 | 30 | 20 | CYL 的主题 API 与 iOS `CYLThemeManager` 相同；XUI 只有 Android | CYL's theme API matches iOS `CYLThemeManager`; XUI is Android only |
| **平均 / Average** | **77 → 87** | **61** | **30** | | |

## [CN]已移植
## [EN]Ported

| 中文 | English |
|:---|:---|
| 对 QMUI 领先的维度，移植了 QMUI（MIT 许可证）的实现，命名改用本库规范（`cyl_` / `CYL`），iOS 一致的公开 API 不变。新增 API 都是仅 Android 的可选扩展，默认关闭，与 iOS 行为相同；移植的文件保留腾讯的版权与 MIT 许可声明。用法见 [Android 库](Android-Library.md#cn仅-android-的扩展)。 | For the dimensions where QMUI was ahead, its implementation (MIT License) was ported, renamed to this library's conventions (`cyl_` / `CYL`), with the iOS-matching public API unchanged. Every new API is an opt-in, Android-only extension, off by default, so the behavior matches iOS; the ported files keep Tencent's copyright and MIT notice. Usage: [Android library](Android-Library.md#enandroid-only-extensions). |

| QMUI | CYL | 说明 | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `QMUITabIndicator`、`layoutIndicator…`、`updateIndicatorPosition` | `CYLTabBarIndicator`、`CYLTabBar.cyl_indicator`、`cyl_updateIndicatorPosition` | 指示条与移动、颜色渐变 | The indicator, its move and color blend |
| `MODE_SCROLLABLE`、`setItemSpaceInScrollMode` | `CYLTabBarScrollMode`、`cyl_scrollMode`、`cyl_itemSpaceInScrollMode` | 按内容定宽并可滚动 | Width by content, scrolling |
| `QMUITabView.setSelectFraction`、`setupWithViewPager` | `cyl_swipesBetweenPages`（`CYLTabBarPagesContainer`） | 滑动翻页与标题渐变 | Swiping between pages, blended titles |
| `setupWithViewPager`（ViewPager2） | `cyl_setupWithViewPager2`、`cyl_viewPager2` | 页面放进 App 的 ViewPager2，双向联动 | The pages in the app's ViewPager2, kept in step both ways |
| 按权重分配宽度（`QDTabSegmentSpaceWeightFragment`） | `CYLTabBar.cyl_itemWidthWeights` | 固定模式下按权重分配 Tab 宽度 | Tab widths by weight in the fixed mode |
| `QMUISkinValueBuilder`、`IQMUISkinRuleHandler` | `CYLThemeValueBuilder`、`CYLThemeRuleHandler`、`View.cyl_themeValue` | 主题规则 | Theme rules |
| `QMUISkinLayoutInflaterFactory`、`QMUISkinDef` | `CYLThemeLayoutInflaterFactory`、`app:cyl_theme…` | 布局属性 | Layout attributes |
| `QMUISkinManager.register` / `unRegister` | `CYLThemeValues.register` / `unregister` | 对话框、其他 Activity | Dialogs, other activities |
| `IQMUISkinHandlerSpan`、`IQMUISkinHandlerDecoration`、`IQMUISkinDispatchInterceptor` | `CYLThemeSpan`、`CYLThemeItemDecoration`、`CYLThemeDispatchInterceptor` | Span、列表分割线、拦截 | Spans, list decorations, interception |
| 皮肤 style 中的命名属性（`?attr/name`）与 style 继承 / named skin attributes (`?attr/name`) and style inheritance | 配置文件中的 `CYLTabBarControllerThemes`、`"@name"` 值、回退到基础皮肤（iOS 与 Android） / `CYLTabBarControllerThemes`, `"@name"` values, base skin fallback in configuration files (iOS and Android) | 一个文件同时给出 Tab 与皮肤，见 [配置文件：皮肤](Configuration-File.md#cn皮肤) | One file gives the tabs and the skins, see [configuration file: skins](Configuration-File.md#enskins) |
